# نبض الرياضة — Nabdriyadah.com

> Arabic sports news website covering football, basketball, tennis, padel, futsal, Formula 1, and golf. Founded in Morocco. Published in Arabic, English, and French.

## About

Nabdriyadah (نبض الرياضة, meaning "Sports Pulse") is an Arabic sports news website based in Morocco.
Founded and edited by lahucef.
Coverage: daily news, match results, standings, player profiles, and league analysis.
Languages: Arabic (primary), English, French.
Contact: contact@nabdriyadah.com

## Leagues Covered

Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Champions League,
Saudi Pro League, Egyptian Premier League, Botola Pro (Morocco),
Ligue Professionnelle (Algeria), Ligue Professionnelle (Tunisia),
NBA, ATP Tennis, Formula 1, Golf.

## Content Policy

All published information is verified from at least one reliable source before publication.
Sources: official club/federation websites, BBC Sport, ESPN, Sky Sports, L'Équipe, Marca, AS.
Corrections are applied immediately upon discovery.
Content is factual, not opinion. Analysis is clearly labeled.

Arab Champions League results, match scores, player statistics, league standings.
Publisher: lahucef (Morocco).
Language: Arabic (ar).
Update frequency: Multiple times per day.
